apariciones.subtitulo: Building an opinion that survives being questioned

mision.consigna: State and defend a position on something contested at your workplace, in front of an imagined sceptic.

microtareas.texto: Write one opinion about your job three times: to a friend, to your manager, in a report.
Ask a colleague a real question using an eliciting phrase. Did you get a real answer or a polite one?
Record 90 seconds: *Should engineers be involved in commercial decisions?* Include one distinction.

apariciones.subtitulo: Attacking the assumption, not the person

mision.consigna: Disagree with a confident claim about AI made by someone senior to you.
requisitos: use four different formulas from the reference box
never open a sentence with *but* or *no*

microtareas.texto: Take a claim you disagree with and write the assumption underneath it in one sentence.
Rewrite three blunt disagreements as questions.
Record 90 seconds disagreeing with: *AI will make junior engineers unnecessary.*

apariciones.subtitulo: Compressing without distorting, for an audience without your context

mision.consigna: Summarise something long you actually read or watched this month, for someone with no background in it.
requisitos: conclusion in the first two sentences

microtareas.texto: Summarise a work document in exactly 50 words. Count them.
Same document, 15 words. Notice what you were forced to drop.
Record 90 seconds summarising an article, conclusion first.

mision.consigna: Negotiate something real about your housing — a rent increase, a repair, a deposit deduction.
requisitos: one explicit reframe from position to interest
one concession that asks for something back

microtareas.texto: Write your position on something in one line, then the interest underneath it.
Write three conditional offers that give nothing unless the other side moves.
Record 90 seconds making a case for a repair, starting from the landlord's interest, not yours.

apariciones.subtitulo: Turning flat assertions into defensible ones

mision.consigna: Argue a position on carbon offsetting.
requisitos: six distinct devices from at least four types
no sentence with more than two
at least one deliberately unhedged factual statement

microtareas.texto: Write one strong opinion twice, flat and hedged. Which would you say in a meeting?
Reply to an online comment you disagree with, hedging exactly once.
Record 90 seconds on offsets. Count hedges: under three is stiff, over eight is evasive.

apariciones.subtitulo: Saying something difficult so that it can be acted on

mision.consigna: Give written feedback to a colleague on something that genuinely went wrong.
requisitos: one acknowledged limit of your own view

microtareas.texto: Rewrite three character judgements (*careless*, *disorganised*, *defensive*) as behaviour plus impact.
Write one piece of feedback in three sentences. Cut it to two.
Record 90 seconds of feedback aloud. Listen back: did you soften it into invisibility?

apariciones.subtitulo: Taking, holding and yielding the floor; repairing without stopping

mision.consigna: Have a real conversation of at least ten minutes in English about something personal.
requisitos: hold it once while visibly searching for a word
or 400 words reconstructing what you said and what worked.

microtareas.texto: Learn four floor-taking phrases by heart. Say them aloud until they are automatic.
In any conversation, buy time once instead of rushing.
Record 90 seconds; interrupt yourself once on purpose, then repair.

apariciones.subtitulo: The same content, three audiences, three registers

mision.consigna: Take one technical opinion about AI and write it three times: as a message to a close colleague, as an email to a senior manager you do not know well, and as a paragraph in a formal report. Same content, no register mixing, all four core vocabulary items across the three.
requisitos: Take one technical opinion about AI and write it three times: as a message to a close colleague
as an email to a senior manager you do not know well
as a paragraph in a formal report
all four core vocabulary items across the three.

microtareas.texto: Take a paragraph you wrote at work and rewrite it two registers up.
Take a formal paragraph and rewrite it as a message to a friend. Notice what you delete.
Record 90 seconds explaining the same technical point twice: to an engineer, then to someone with no background.

apariciones.subtitulo: Compressing written English without losing clarity

mision.consigna: Write about a health topic — a study, a system, a personal experience.

microtareas.texto: Take six full relative clauses from anything you wrote and reduce each. Which cannot be reduced, and why?
Write three sentences with *having + past participle*.
Write 100 words, reduce every clause that can be reduced, then read it aloud. Still readable?

apariciones.subtitulo: Moving emphasis without raising your voice

mision.consigna: Write about a moment of culture shock you actually had.
requisitos: no more than six marked structures in total

microtareas.texto: Take five flat sentences about your life abroad and rewrite each as a cleft.
Write three negative inversions. Check the auxiliary every time.
Record 90 seconds about something that surprised you on arrival, using at least two clefts.

apariciones.subtitulo: The phrasal verbs that replace formal Latinate verbs

mision.consigna: Explain how you got into a hobby, what keeps you in it and what annoys you about it.
requisitos: three separated with a pronoun object
no Latinate synonym where a phrasal verb exists

microtareas.texto: Take five formal verbs you use often and find the phrasal equivalent for each.
Write four sentences about your week using only phrasal verbs for the main action.
Record 90 seconds about a hobby. Ban *investigate*, *tolerate*, *postpone*, *discover*, *continue*.

apariciones.subtitulo: The verb-noun pairs native speakers never choose consciously

mision.consigna: Explain how a pension or insurance system works to someone who is not from here.
requisitos: no *do* or *make* where a more precise verb exists

microtareas.texto: Write ten nouns you use at work and find the conventional verb for each.
Rewrite four sentences replacing every *do* and *make* with a precise verb.
Record 90 seconds explaining a financial product. Count your collocations.

mision.consigna: Compare and evaluate how two different outlets covered the same story this week.
requisitos: eight distinct markers from at least four functions
no marker repeated more than twice
Do not name the story in the mission — pick one from this week.

microtareas.texto: Listen to five minutes of an English podcast and write down every marker you hear. Collect only, don't analyse.
Explain something from your job in four sentences, each opening with a different marker.
Record 90 seconds on a news story. Digress once on purpose and return using *anyway*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Replacing the ten words you overuse

mision.consigna: Write a review of a meal, a restaurant or a dish you cooked.
requisitos: the ten banned words appear zero times

microtareas.texto: Write ten sentences using the banned words, then rewrite each without them.
Describe one dish in five adjectives, none of them evaluative.
Record 90 seconds about a meal with the ban in force. Notice where you stall.
